Gespage – Technical Prerequisites & Installation Preparation Guide
1. Technical Prerequisites
1.1 Gespage Application
The Gespage solution requires installation of the Gespage On-Premise software on a supported server environment. It may coexist on a print server or run separately depending on the deployment architecture.

2. Server Requirements
2.1 On-Premise Server
Gespage can be installed either on:
A dedicated Windows or Linux server
A print server hosting shared print queues
A separate server with only the Agent Service installed
A cloud-hosted server (requires a VPN into the client network)

3. Supported Operating Systems
3.1 Windows Server (Recommended for Windows Environments)
Gespage can be installed on:
Windows Server 2022 or above
Windows Server 2019
For small environments (under 10 workstations), a Windows workstation may act as a print server:
Windows 11
Windows 10 (64-bit)
3.2 Linux Server
Minimum supported distributions:
Debian 11
Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
Recommended:
Debian 12 (Preferred)
A detailed Debian installation guide is available in “Gespage v9 installation on Debian”.

4. Server Hardware Requirements
The server specifications depend on the size of the printer fleet and Gespage features being used.
Important Notes
Windows print servers have limitations—do not exceed 300 print queues per server.
Gespage software requires 5 GB of disk space for installation.
Total disk capacity should be sized based on: 
Retention period of print jobs
Size of spool files
Admin web interface supports Edge, Chrome, and Firefox.

5. Database Requirements
Gespage supports two database engines:
PostgreSQL 15.2 (default, automatically installed)
Microsoft SQL Server 2016 or later
The database may also be hosted externally.

5. Database Requirements
Gespage supports two database engines:
PostgreSQL 15.2 (default, automatically installed)
Microsoft SQL Server 2016 or later
The database may also be hosted externally.

6. Network Requirements
Gespage requires several network ports to be opened depending on services enabled (Application Server, Agent, Mobile Service, eTerminals).
Refer to:
Gespage Administration Manual
Gespage eTerminal Manual

7. Architecture Overview
7.1 Standard Configuration
Gespage server consists of four main services:
Gespage Application Server
Manages:
Print logic
User accounts
Web interface
eTerminals and device management
Gespage Print/Agent Service
Handles:
Windows or Linux print queues
Gespage Mobile Service
Supports:
Mobile printing
Advanced scanning
Gespage Mobile Gateway
Manages:
Gespage mobile app communication
A local PostgreSQL database is included by default.

7.2 Multi-Site Architecture
For distributed environments with limited bandwidth, Gespage offers features like:
Gespage Remote
Gespage Tracker Agent
Refer to the Gespage Administration Manual for multi-site design best practices.

8. Prepare the Installation
8.1 Printer Configuration
8.1.1 Print2Me (Pull Printing)
Requires a common printer driver across all compatible printers.
Enables secure, user-released printing.
8.1.2 Print Accounting
Gespage parser supports spool file languages:
PostScript
PCL 5/6
XPS
For unsupported languages, Gespage depends on Windows spooler information.
⚠️ Important:
Print flows from ERP systems must be validated before deployment.

8.2 User Configuration
Users may be created using:
LDAP synchronization
CSV Import
Manual creation (Admin web interface)
Dynamic creation during first authentication
Self-registration via User Interface

8.2 User Configuration
Users may be created using:
LDAP synchronization
CSV Import
Manual creation (Admin web interface)
Dynamic creation during first authentication
Self-registration via User Interface
Exception
Public environments with payment stations do not require pre-created accounts.

8.2.1 LDAP Synchronization
Supported directories:
Active Directory (AD)
Azure AD
OpenLDAP
Configurable attributes include:
Card number
Print code
Other custom fields
Validation is performed against LDAP for authentication.

8.2.2 CSV Import
Used when no directory is available.
Requires a Gespage-formatted CSV.
You must contact Gespage Support for the correct CSV template before installation.

8.3 Client Workstations
8.3.1 Print Submission
By default, users are identified by the OS login when printing to shared queues.
Without a print server, Gespage Agent must be installed on workstations.
8.3.2 Gespage Popup
Popup software is required for:
Shared stations without unique user logins
Environments where OS login ≠ Gespage account
Supported on:
Windows
macOS
Linux
Requires Java 11 or higher.

9. Gespage Features Overview
9.1 Gespage Mobile Printing
Methods:
Web Printing
Email Printing
App Printing (Android & iOS)
Web Printing
Accessible via Gespage user web portal.
Email Printing
Requires dedicated mailbox(es).
If printers share a universal driver, one mailbox can serve all.
App Printing
Requires:
Internal Wi-Fi access to server or
Publicly accessible server with a valid DNS

9.2 Gespage User Interface
End users can:
Submit print jobs
View account info
Recharge credit (if web payment enabled)
Requirements:
Device must access Gespage server
If public access is required: 
Public IP
Public DNS (e.g., print.mydomain.com)
SSL certificate (installed by Gespage Support)

10. Gespage Scanning & OCR
If OCR is required for scanned documents:
Install Tesseract 3.05.01 on the Gespage server.
Refer to the Gespage Manual for installation instructions.
